title: The Preprocessor
summary: Before compiling, the preprocessor runs the lines starting with #. #include pastes in a file, #define replaces names with text, and #if keeps or drops code. Macros are text replacement, not functions, so parenthesise everything and avoid arguments with side effects. assert checks your assumptions while you develop.

cards.q: #define DOUBLE(x) x + x. What is 3 * DOUBLE(2)?
What does an include guard prevent?
cards.a:
A header's contents appearing twice when it is included twice

cards.q: Why is MAX(i++, j) risky with #define MAX(a, b) ((a) > (b) ? (a) : (b))?
cards.a:
